### Rock-Paper-Scissors (Janken)

![](../../../images/usage-1792771640243.webp)

> Trigger words: `じゃんけん` / `janken` / `グー` / `チョキ` / `パー`

- Do you think your win rate in rock-paper-scissors is 1/2, or 1/3 even if you count ties as losses?
- By bringing in the janken master ["Keisuke Honda"](https://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E6%9C%AC%E7%94%B0%E3%81%A8%E3%81%98%E3%82%83%E3%82%93%E3%81%91%E3%82%93), this janken has dramatically reduced your win rate to a mere 5%.
- The janken master descends! Who will prevail in this fierce battle!!
	- Viewers compete against each other over who wins, which also increases comment counts.
	- [A free bottle of cola for winning](https://www.j-cast.com/2019/04/17355553.html) might even be within reach!?
